{{Top|leg}}
'''''Logan''''' was a pair of [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. They were part of a strike force against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Laantis]]'', with the transports launching warheads at the frigate. The transports along with the other Rebels were defeated and the transports were destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
This article assumes "Medium" difficulty. In "Hard" the flight group increases to four transports.
